verdict: ACP NOT READY - capability remains shadow, experimental, and architecturally unresolved; do not package now

candidate_package.template: packages/capabilities/model-selection (stdlib-only leaf) or governance-provider-framework core (single dep on ugence-governance-contracts)

prerequisites_before_any_migration: Resolve the authority definition: robotics V1 ACP mints a ControlAuthorization grant (authorizes) while cloud/console ACP explicitly never authorizes. Pick ONE meaning for the product.
Decide which world the product package serves (robotics core vs console digital clearance vs governance-chain seam) - they do not share code today.
Factor a neutral clearance kernel out of the robotics-domain envelopes (CanonicalWorldState/Candidate are robotics-shaped).
Stabilize a real request/result contract: today there is no ClearanceRequest/Result/Status/ReasonCode family; consumers deep-import .cloud.* enums by .value.
Migrate consumers (cer_v0_*) off deep .cloud.* imports onto a curated public surface.
Decide one-time-use / consumption ownership (currently no consumption ledger; likely belongs to an execution/idempotency ledger, not ACP).
Amend or reconcile the ACP V1 local freeze (combined digest 8f8660e293308cf94c983a26a2ae69c9) because converting internal imports to relative imports changes module content and breaks the digest.

files_that_would_move_if_ready.note: world_state.py and envelopes.py are robotics-domain-shaped; a governance ACP would need a neutral kernel, so a verbatim move is NOT behavior-neutral for a governance product.

compatibility.object_identity_requirement: cer_v0_* rely on exact enum identity of AuthorizationVerdict/CombinedOutcome/CloudRecommendation and CloudWorldState schema; a move must preserve identity via sys.modules aliasing (as model-selection/decision-authority do).
compatibility.mechanism: logic-free re-export shim at legacy path; NO meta-path hooks, NO duplicated source, NO fallback imports

freeze_impact.platform_freeze: NONE - ACP is not in platform/PLATFORM_FREEZE_V1.json
freeze_impact.acp_local_freeze: AFFECTED - ACP_V1_FREEZE.md per-module SHA-256 digests would change under import rewrites; a freeze amendment or replay re-baseline would be required (out of scope for the audit).

equivalence_standard: semantic equivalence (deterministic before/after capture of status + reason codes + obligations + fingerprints + exception/expiry behavior), NOT byte-identical, because a governance ACP requires neutralizing robotics-domain envelopes and curating a public surface.
proposed_phase_sequence: P1 skeleton (metadata/version/curated API, no behavior change)
P2 core source move (verbatim + relative imports) - blocked until neutral kernel + freeze reconciliation
P3 compatibility surface (legacy re-exports, object identity proof)
P4 consumer migration (cer_v0_*; retain shadow/research consumers)
P7 closure (post-merge validation, no policy change)
